_about: Manuka Oval (Canberra) as it is in 2026, for build.py. Frame: x east, y north from the OSM pitch way 4941717's node centroid (lat -35.3180995, lon 149.1345344); the field centre is C. Bearings are compass degrees from C; d is metres past the fence (the curve in fence, fitted to Google Earth) along its outward normal; z is metres above the field. Plan read off aerial imagery (Esri World Imagery, unwrapped round the fence) and OSM; heights and rows by eye from Google Earth 3D (2026-11-22). Looks only.

lower._: the low front terrace all round: light grey seats, 8 rows to the concourse
lower._z: Google Earth's status bar: 1 m at 2 to 5 m out, 2 m at 6 to 9 m

astands._: the stands under thin dark roofs with white A-frames on top: rows of mixed-colour seats. Ends, roof fronts and backs traced on a calibrated Google Earth top-down (2026-11-22, camera 691 m over the turf, 0.436 m a pixel, lean-corrected to roof height); roof_b0/roof_b1 bound the dark roof where a translucent canopy (canopies) covers the rest

north._h: roof heights from Google Earth's status bar from angled cameras (shape/oblique.py heights)
north._z: rows: Google Earth's status bar reads 3 to 4 m at 12 to 14 m out (under the roof's front) and the roof 8 to 9 m; the back row kept 1.9 m or more under the roof

west._h: roof heights from Google Earth's status bar from angled cameras (shape/oblique.py heights)
west._z: rows: Google Earth's status bar reads 3 to 4 m at 12 to 14 m out (under the roof's front) and the roof 8 to 9 m; the back row kept 1.9 m or more under the roof

southeast._h: roof heights from Google Earth's status bar from angled cameras (shape/oblique.py heights)
southeast._z: rows: Google Earth's status bar reads 3 to 4 m at 12 to 14 m out (under the roof's front) and the roof 8 to 9 m; the back row kept 1.9 m or more under the roof

bradman._: Bradman Stand: 5 front rows, a plinth wall, 16 rows to the boxes under a deep white roof; ends, roof front and back and the two vomitories traced on the calibrated Google Earth top-down (2026-11-22), roof lean-corrected at roof_top
bradman._h: roof top 13 m from Google Earth's status bar (100 probes from two angled cameras, every one 13); front seats 3 m at 9 m out the same way; rows raked to fit under the roof
bradman._lean: roof edges traced again at its measured 13 m (the lean moves them 0.5 m out)

red._: the open red-seat terraces on the east side: three blocks with stairs between; blocks, their aisles and depth traced on the calibrated Google Earth top-down (2026-11-22)

hill._: the east bank: grass slope, path, gravel terrace, box hedge on top

media._: the media and corporate building over the southern seats (in OSM's Menzies Terrace): curved, five levels behind bronze fins and dark glass, the upper four stepping back floor by floor to the white roof deck at 21 m (Google Earth's status bar from angled cameras: deck 21 m, the face 14.5 m out at 14 to 15 m up) with rounded back corners. Deck ends, front and back and the ledge traced on the calibrated Google Earth top-down (2026-11-22); the form from Google Earth 3D from the field; roof_back_at: the deck's back edge [bearing, d] (the block's back wall 1 m inside it); deck_outline: the white deck's outline [bearing, d] traced row by row (front corners cut back, the back corners rounded); the front is dark glass under the ledge (Google Earth 3D close from the field: no fins on it), the fins on the back and ends

ledge._: front: the dark band's front on the top-down (the first upper floor's slab); z_front, fascia: no longer used

media._lean: deck traced again at its measured 21 m (the lean moves it 0.8 m toward the field)

screen._: the video screen on a steel frame, north-east; ends, face (d at the ends: a straight box) and depth traced on the calibrated straight-down shot (shape/README)
screen._h: face 13.3 m (middle) to 14.6 m (ends) out, 6.5 to 14 m up: Google Earth's status bar swept up the face from an angled camera

scoreboard._: Jack Fingleton Scoreboard , heritage, from the MCG; footprint traced on the calibrated Google Earth top-down (2026-11-22): [bearing, d] corners, front edge first

nest._: camera and commentary box right behind Hawke Terrace's roof: b 5.0-14.2, d 20.8-24.5 traced on a calibrated straight-down shot; top 16 m from Google Earth's status bar

towers._: six 47 m light towers (2013), leaning in so no part tops Parliament House's height rule; OSM masts

residence._: the 1930s curator's residence, two storeys, cream render, terracotta hipped roof

fence._: the boundary fence (the white pickets on their kerb) traced on a straight-down Google Earth shot (range calibrated from its own lat/lon readout to 0.16 m), r(bearing) about C as a Fourier series to order 8: r = a0 + sum(a_k cos k b + b_k sin k b). tools/grounds/manuka/shape/

canopies._: translucent pale canopies over the stands' ends (Google Earth top-down: pale (195, 219, 236), the frame showing through)
